baseline.description: Four genuine source-control records independently preserve identity, hashes, page QA and epistemic labels before a unified legal authority passport.
baseline.name: DISTRIBUTED_LEGAL_SOURCE_CONTROL_RECORDS

legal_proof_gaps.promotion_effect: LRA currentness may be promoted only for the exact verified provisions.
legal_proof_gaps.requirement: Latest consolidated Labour Relations Act amendments and commencement notices
legal_proof_gaps.safe_action: Retrieve and compare the current official amendment and commencement record before proposition-level reliance.

legal_proof_gaps.promotion_effect: CCMA Rules currentness may be promoted without changing the page-QA history.
legal_proof_gaps.requirement: Current CCMA Rules amendments, commencement and operative consolidated text after the 2023 carrier
legal_proof_gaps.safe_action: Verify the latest official Gazette and effective rules against the stored 42-page carrier.

legal_proof_gaps.promotion_effect: Historical Schedule 8 and current Code application can be classified for a defined issue.
legal_proof_gaps.requirement: Exact transitional and subject-matter scope of the 2025 Code of Practice: Dismissal
legal_proof_gaps.safe_action: Read the current official Code and commencement material for the precise issue being analysed.

legal_proof_gaps.promotion_effect: Source-control work can be connected to facts without importing them into this experiment.
legal_proof_gaps.requirement: Matter-specific primary facts and contrary evidence
legal_proof_gaps.safe_action: Use a separately authorised matter packet with native evidence, case wall and adverse-evidence schedule.

legal_proof_gaps.promotion_effect: A bounded procedural route may be stated; jurisdiction is not presumed.
legal_proof_gaps.safe_action: Test the pleaded dispute, relief, timing and forum against current primary authority.

legal_proof_gaps.promotion_effect: Only supported element-level propositions may advance.
legal_proof_gaps.requirement: Protected-disclosure elements, route, good faith or reasonableness and causation
legal_proof_gaps.safe_action: Map every statutory element to primary evidence and preserve alternative causal explanations.

legal_proof_gaps.promotion_effect: Relief can be framed without overstating the decision-maker's competence.
legal_proof_gaps.safe_action: Separate recommendation, approval, adjudicative power and implementation authority.

legal_proof_gaps.promotion_effect: Institutional-policy propositions can remain separate from national-law propositions.
legal_proof_gaps.requirement: Current operative institutional disciplinary policy and relationship to national law
legal_proof_gaps.safe_action: Verify the current policy version, approval, scope and conflict rule before use.

objective: Compile genuine legal source-control records into one authority passport that separates identity, integrity, review coverage, currentness, supersession and matter application without deciding any case.

assertions.statement: The receipt records five required official sources.
The required official-source raw-byte gate passed.
The separate secondary-resource archive gate did not pass.
Two secondary CCMA information-sheet source IDs remained provider-blocked.
Raw-byte identity for required primary sources does not prove base-Act consolidated currentness, proposition-level legal research, real-case outcomes or consequential authority.
The Labour Relations Act register status requires an amendment check.
The register notes Act 66 of 1995 with later amendments and requires verification of latest commencement and amendment notices before final reliance.
assertions.value: Act 66 of 1995 with later amendments; verify latest commencement and amendment notices before final reliance

assertions.statement: The 2025 Code of Practice: Dismissal is registered as a current official source.
The register records an effective date of 2025-09-04.
The register identifies Government Gazette 53294, General Notice 3470.
The Protected Disclosures Act is registered as a current official source with the 2023 amendment noted.
The register notes Act 5 of 2017 and Judicial Matters Amendment Act 15 of 2023 effective 3 April 2024.
assertions.value: Includes Act 5 of 2017 and Judicial Matters Amendment Act 15 of 2023 effective 3 April 2024

truth_boundary: This packet may measure legal source-control completeness only. It may not decide a case, determine jurisdiction, establish protected-disclosure status or causation, select a remedy, authorise a filing, or claim that all legal sources are current.
